# CareNest AI

> Intelligent Elderly Care & Medication Management Ecosystem

CareNest AI bridges elderly parents, adult children, and attending physicians through an accessible, voice-first medication management platform with real-time biometric telemetry and clinical AI safety auditing.

## Core Capabilities
- Senior Safe Mode: High-contrast, tactile UI with large typography, multilingual voice readouts (English, Tamil, Hindi, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Spanish), and 1-tap emergency calling to family and doctors.
- Caretaker Command Dashboard: Clinical schedule management, drug-drug interaction screening via Google Gemini 2.5 Flash, real-time vitals telemetry (BP, Glucose, Heart Rate, SpO2), and digital health report vault.
- Proactive Family Alerts: Automated notification engine alerting caregivers of missed doses or emergency triggers.
- Privacy & Rate Limiting: 5-attempt brute-force lockout protection, 0-mock live adherence tracking.

## API & Interaction Endpoints
- Web App: https://catalyst-hackathon-lime.vercel.app/
- Passcode Security: CARE-8492
- OpenAPI / Spec: https://catalyst-hackathon-lime.vercel.app/llms-full.txt
